# System libraries installed before R. One per line; # starts a comment.
#
# These are pre-filled rather than left to pak's system-requirements lookup,
# which may not have a mapping for a non-LTS Ubuntu. If a package fails to
# compile complaining about a missing header, add it here and rebuild — that
# invalidates the R layer, so it costs a full rebuild. Adding it in a running
# sandbox with `sudo apt-get install` first is the faster way to find out which
# one you need.

# curl / httr / openssl
libcurl4-openssl-dev
libssl-dev

# xml2, and rvest through it
libxml2-dev

# systemfonts / textshaping / ragg — the tidyverse graphics stack
libfontconfig1-dev
libfreetype6-dev
libharfbuzz-dev
libfribidi-dev

# ragg / png / jpeg / tiff image devices
libpng-dev
libjpeg-dev
libtiff-dev

# stringi and friends
libicu-dev
zlib1g-dev
